name: BBQ
intro: BBQ（Bias Benchmark for Question Answering）是技术报告中反复引用的问答偏见评测，用于检查模型在不同社会属性语境下是否产生偏见回答。
build_method: 有出处的偏见模板手写, 四条件扩展, 五人一致性验证
build_method_en: Sourced bias-template writing, four-condition expansion, five-rater agreement validation
intro_en: BBQ, the Bias Benchmark for Question Answering, is repeatedly cited in the technical reports as a QA bias benchmark for checking whether models produce biased answers across social contexts.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2110.08193v2 §3.1, §3.2, §3.3, §4, Figure 1, §5, and Appendix D. Authors write sourced templates for nine bias categories plus two intersectional categories, with at least 25 templates per category. Each template expands into ambiguous/disambiguated context crossed with negative/non-negative questions, balanced answer order, and one of ten equivalent UNKNOWN phrases. Validation samples one question from each of the four conditions and assigns five people to each; every question must reach at least 4/5 agreement. Failure revises the template and repeats all four checks before the final 58,492-item release. Evaluation reports accuracy, sDIS, and ambiguity-adjusted sAMB.
